summary: Change Agents Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to an equity purchase agreement with Hudson Global Ventures, LLC. The amendment reduces the per-share purchase price to $0.20 and adjusts the applicable trading amount for each put based on tiered VWAP/closing price thresholds, ranging from $15,000 to $450,000. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special-situation event. The filing contains no change of control, restructuring, or strategic action. What to watch: potential dilution from future puts under the equity line, though no specific put has been exercised or announced.
